cards.ex: Back out means you promised to do something, then you decide not to do it. Ellie tells Carl there is no backing out of the trip.
exs: Do not back out of a promise you made to a friend.
lg: 先拉钩答应，再缩回去，就不算数了。
cards.note: 电影里 Ellie 说 No backing out：去 Paradise Falls 这件事不许反悔。 原句：“Cross it! Cross your heart! Good, you promised. No backing out.”（画呀！画十字发誓！好，你答应了。不许反悔。）

cards.ex: Cross your heart means you promise, and you trace a small cross over your heart. Ellie says “Cross your heart” before she shows Carl her book.
exs: Cross your heart before you break a promise.
lg: 手指在胸口画一个小叉，表示这句话当真。
cards.note: 这里不是人名。Ellie 说的是 Cross your heart：在胸口画十字，表示发誓。 原句：“Cross your heart. Do it!”（在胸口画十字发誓。快！）

cards.ex: A blimp is a big airship filled with gas. Ellie asks Carl to take them to Paradise Falls in a blimp.
exs: Ellie wanted Carl to fly them there in a blimp.
lg: 一个鼓鼓的大气囊，下面吊着小舱，能在天上慢慢飞。
cards.note: Ellie 口中的 blimp，就是新闻片里 Muntz 的那种飞艇。更正式的说法是 dirigible。 原句：“That's it! You can take us there in a blimp!”（有了！你可以开飞艇带我们去！）

cards.ex: A clubhouse is the little home base of a club. Ellie wants to move her clubhouse next to Paradise Falls.
exs: Ellie wants her clubhouse right next to the waterfall.
lg: 只属于这个小团体的屋子，别人不能随便进。
cards.note: 原句：“I'm gonna move my clubhouse there and park it right next to the falls.”（我要把我的俱乐部小屋搬到那儿，就放在瀑布旁边。）

cards.ex: Out of means from inside something, or from a direction. Ellie rips a picture out of a library book, and she also calls the wind “out of the east.”
exs: Ellie ripped the picture out of a library book.
lg: 东西原来在里面，被拿到外面来。风从东边来，也说 out of the east。
cards.note: 两个电影里的用法：winds out of the east（风从东边来）；ripped it out of a book（从书里撕下来）。 原句：“It's a beautiful day. Winds out of the east at 10 knots.”（天气真好。东风，风速 10 节。）

cards.ex: Ripped means tore something by pulling. Ellie ripped a page out of a library book.
exs: She ripped the picture out of a book.
lg: 用手一扯，纸离开了书。
cards.note: 这是 rip 的过去式。事情已经发生，所以用 ripped。 原句：“I ripped this right out of a library book.”（这是我从图书馆的书上直接撕下来的。）

cards.ex: Swear means you promise something very seriously. Ellie makes Carl swear he will not tell anyone about her book.
exs: You have to swear you will not tell anyone.
lg: 把一句承诺说得很重，好像不许反悔。
cards.note: 原句：“You'll have to swear you will not tell anyone.”（你得发誓不告诉任何人。）

cards.ex: Cheer up means to help someone feel happier. Ellie climbs through the window to cheer Carl up after he breaks his arm.
exs: A visit from a friend can cheer up a bad day.
lg: 人闷着，你过去把气氛托起来。
cards.note: 电影里 Ellie 说 cheerin' up，就是 cheer up 的口语说法。 原句：“Thought you might need a little cheering up.”（我想你可能需要一点安慰，让你开心点。）

cards.ex: Aboard means on a ship or airship, or inside the group. Ellie says “Welcome aboard” when Carl joins her explorer club.
exs: Ellie said welcome aboard when Carl joined the club.
lg: 人已经站到船上，或者被收进这个小团体。
cards.note: 原句：“All right, you're in. Welcome aboard.”（好吧，你入会了。欢迎加入。）

cards.ex: Goggles are glasses that protect your eyes from wind. Young Carl and Ellie wear flight goggles like Charles Muntz.
exs: Carl put on his goggles before he crossed the beam.
lg: 两只圆镜片用皮带勒在眼睛上，飞行时挡风。
cards.note: 通常用复数 goggles，因为是一副。 原句：“Only explorers get in here, not just any kid off the street with a helmet and a pair of goggles.”（只有探险家才能进来，不是随便哪个戴着头盔和护目镜的街头小孩都行。）

cards.ex: A helmet is a hard hat that protects your head. Ellie wears a flight helmet in her pretend cockpit.
exs: Ellie took off her helmet and her hair stuck out.
lg: 扣在头上的硬帽子，摔下来时护住脑袋。
cards.note: 原句：“Only explorers get in here, not just any kid off the street with a helmet and a pair of goggles.”（只有探险家才能进来，不是随便哪个戴着头盔和护目镜的街头小孩都行。）

cards.ex: Exclusive means only a special group may join. Ellie says her club is exclusive: only explorers get in.
exs: The club is exclusive, so not every kid can walk in.
lg: 门开一条缝，只给自己人。
cards.note: 原句：“Don't you know this is an exclusive club?”（你不知道这是个专属俱乐部吗？）

cards.ex: Hail is small balls of ice that fall in a storm. Ellie shouts “Lightning! Hail!” while she pretends to fly.
exs: Hail started to hit the pretend airship.
lg: 天上掉下来的小冰球，砸在船上噼啪响。
cards.note: 这里是天气里的冰雹，不是 hail a taxi（招手叫车），也不是 hail someone as a hero（把某人称赞为英雄）。 原句：“Aw! It's a puppy! Ah! No time! A storm! Lightning. Hail.”（哇！是只小狗！啊！没时间了！暴风雨！闪电。冰雹。）

cards.ex: A storm is heavy rain and wind, often with lightning. Ellie yells that a storm is coming, and later a real storm throws the house around.
exs: A sudden storm can throw a little house around in the sky.
lg: 风、雨、雷一起压过来。
cards.note: 名词是暴风雨。storm 也可以作动词，表示气冲冲地走，但这部电影里先记天气。 原句：“Aw! It's a puppy! Ah! No time! A storm! Lightning. Hail.”（哇！是只小狗！啊！没时间了！暴风雨！闪电。冰雹。）

cards.ex: Weather is what the sky is doing: sun, wind, rain, or a storm. Ellie tells her hamster to enter the weather in the logbook.
exs: Ellie wrote the weather in her logbook.
lg: 飞行员先看天，再把风和能见度记下来。
cards.note: 原句：“Visibility unlimited. Enter the weather in the logbook.”（能见度无限。把天气记进航海日志。）

cards.ex: Unlimited means there is no limit. Ellie says visibility is unlimited, so she can see very far on a clear day.
exs: On a clear day the visibility is unlimited.
lg: 眼睛能看多远，就看多远，没有一条截止线。
cards.note: 原句：“Visibility unlimited. Enter the weather in the logbook.”（能见度无限。把天气记进航海日志。）

cards.ex: Visibility is how far you can see. Pilots talk about visibility before they fly.
exs: Good visibility means a pilot can see a long way.
lg: 空气清的时候看得到山；雾里就什么都没有。
cards.note: 原句：“Visibility unlimited. Enter the weather in the logbook.”（能见度无限。把天气记进航海日志。）

cards.ex: A rudder is the flat piece that steers a ship or airship. Ellie calls “Rudders eighteen degrees towards the south.”
exs: The pilot moved the rudder to turn the airship.
lg: 船尾那块能左右摆的板，一摆，船就转向。
cards.note: 原句：“Rudders 18 degrees towards the south.”（方向舵向南转 18 度。）

cards.ex: Starboard is the right side of a ship or airship when you face the front. Ellie shouts “Hard to starboard.”
exs: Hard to starboard means turn the ship sharply to the right.
lg: 脸朝船头时，你的右手边就是 starboard。
cards.note: 和 port（左舷）相对。记的时候可以想：starboard 里有 star，右手边。 原句：“Mount Rushmore! Hard to starboard!”（拉什莫尔山！右满舵！）

cards.ex: Hurdle means to jump over something. The newsreel says Muntz hurdles mountains in his airship, while little Carl jumps the cracks in the sidewalk.
exs: The explorer can hurdle a canyon in his airship.
lg: 不从旁边绕，而是从障碍上翻过去。
cards.note: 也可以作名词，指跨栏那个栏架。新闻片里是动词：He hurdles Pike's Peak. 原句：“He hurdles Pikes Peak.”（他飞越了派克斯峰。）

cards.ex: A dirigible is a large airship you can steer. Muntz flies one called the Spirit of Adventure.
exs: Muntz landed his dirigible in New Hampshire.
lg: 比 blimp 更正式的名字：一艘能转向的大气艇。
cards.note: Ellie 说 blimp，新闻片说 dirigible，指的是同一类飞艇。 原句：“Here's Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.”（这是查尔斯·蒙兹在驾驶他那艘著名的飞艇。）

cards.ex: Famous means lots of people know you. The newsreel shows Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.
exs: The famous explorer waved from his airship.
lg: 闪光灯对着他，因为大家都认识这张脸。
cards.note: 原句：“Here's Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.”（这是查尔斯·蒙兹在驾驶他那艘著名的飞艇。）

cards.ex: Piloting means flying and steering an aircraft. The newsreel says Charles Muntz is piloting his famous dirigible.
exs: Muntz is piloting the Spirit of Adventure.
lg: 手在舵轮上，人负责让这艘船往哪飞。
cards.note: 词表里是 piloting，不是 pilot。pilot 可以是名词“飞行员”，也可以是动词“驾驶”。 原句：“Here's Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.”（这是查尔斯·蒙兹在驾驶他那艘著名的飞艇。）

cards.ex: A beast is a large wild animal or a monster. Muntz promises to capture the beast of Paradise Falls alive.
exs: Muntz wants to capture the beast alive.
lg: 还没有被科学命名的大动物，新闻片把它叫成怪物。
cards.note: 原句：“Humiliated, Muntz vows a return to Paradise Falls and promises to capture the beast alive!”（蒙兹受了羞辱，发誓要重返天堂瀑布，并承诺要活捉那头怪兽！）

cards.ex: Capture means to catch someone or something and hold it. Muntz wants to capture the beast alive, not just bring back bones.
exs: He promised to capture the animal and clear his name.
lg: 不是打死，是抓住并留住。
cards.note: 原句：“Humiliated, Muntz vows a return to Paradise Falls and promises to capture the beast alive!”（蒙兹受了羞辱，发誓要重返天堂瀑布，并承诺要活捉那头怪兽！）

cards.ex: Vow means to promise in a strong, serious way. Muntz vows to return to Paradise Falls and not come back until he finds the beast.
exs: Muntz will vow to bring the beast back alive.
lg: 比普通的 promise 更重，像当众立下的誓。
cards.note: 也可以作名词：a vow。新闻片里是动词 vows。 原句：“Humiliated, Muntz vows a return to Paradise Falls and promises to capture the beast alive!”（蒙兹受了羞辱，发誓要重返天堂瀑布，并承诺要活捉那头怪兽！）

cards.ex: Strip of means to take away a title or a right. The explorers' organization strips Muntz of his membership.
exs: The club can strip a member of his badge.
lg: 把别人身上的头衔摘掉，人还在，资格没了。
cards.note: 电影里不是脱衣服，也不是一条窄地。记 strip someone of something：剥夺某人的某样东西。 原句：“The organization strips Muntz of his membership.”（该组织取消了蒙兹的会员资格。）

cards.ex: An organization is a formal group with a name and rules. In the film it is the National Explorers Society.
exs: The organization took away his membership.
lg: 有名字、有规则、能做决定的一群人。
cards.note: 原句：“The organization strips Muntz of his membership.”（该组织取消了蒙兹的会员资格。）

cards.ex: A skeleton is the full set of bones. Muntz brings back a giant bird skeleton, and scientists say it is not real.
exs: Scientists studied the giant bird skeleton.
lg: 肉没了，只剩一整副骨头，被当成发现摆出来。
cards.note: 原句：“The National Explorers Society accuses Muntz of fabricating the skeleton.”（国家探险家协会指控蒙兹伪造了这副骨架。）

cards.ex: Fabricate means to invent something false or build a fake. Scientists say Muntz fabricated the skeleton.
exs: People said he might fabricate the whole story.
lg: 本来没有，却做出一个看起来像真的东西。
cards.note: 也可以表示“制造”。电影里是贬义：伪造骨头。 原句：“The National Explorers Society accuses Muntz of fabricating the skeleton.”（国家探险家协会指控蒙兹伪造了这副骨架。）

cards.ex: Accuse means to say someone did something wrong. The society accuses Muntz of faking the skeleton.
exs: The society will accuse him of a fake discovery.
lg: 手指着一个人，说错在他。
cards.note: 原句：“The National Explorers Society accuses Muntz of fabricating the skeleton.”（国家探险家协会指控蒙兹伪造了这副骨架。）

cards.ex: Cry foul means to say something is unfair or against the rules. Scientists cry foul about Muntz's skeleton.
exs: The scientists cry foul when the bones look fake.
lg: 比赛里举手说“这球犯规了”。这里是科学家觉得发现不老实。
cards.note: 不是臭味，也不是鸟类的 foul。记 cry foul：喊一声“这不公平”。 原句：“But what's this? Scientists cry foul.”（可这是怎么回事？科学家们大喊不公。）

cards.ex: A scientist is a person who studies the natural world and asks for proof. The scientists do not trust Muntz's skeleton.
exs: A scientist asked for proof of the giant bird.
lg: 不看热闹，要看骨头是不是经得起检查。
cards.note: 原句：“But what's this? Scientists cry foul.”（可这是怎么回事？科学家们大喊不公。）

cards.ex: Swell is an old-fashioned way to say great or wonderful. The announcer says “what a swell monster.”
exs: In old movies, swell means wonderful.
lg: 1930 年代的人竖起大拇指说：这可真不错。
cards.note: 现代英语里 swell 更常是动词“肿胀、增大”。新闻片用的是当年的形容词：很棒。 原句：“And, golly, what a swell monster this is!”（哎呀，这怪物可真了不起！）

cards.ex: Golly is an old, gentle way to show surprise. The announcer says “And golly, what a swell monster.”
exs: Golly, that airship is longer than a city block.
lg: 吃惊，但不是骂人，像轻轻拍一下桌子。
cards.note: 它不变形。口语里单独放在句前。不要用它的词形去套名词或动词。 原句：“And, golly, what a swell monster this is!”（哎呀，这怪物可真了不起！）

cards.zh: 最棒的人或东西（老俚语）
cards.ex: The bee's knees is old slang for the best person or thing. The locals consider Muntz the bee's knees.
exs: In the 1930s, the bee's knees meant the very best.
lg: 老电影里的最高夸奖，相当于今天说 the best。
cards.note: 整段一起记，不要拆开理解成蜜蜂的膝盖。现在很少有人认真这么说，听到会觉得很复古。 原句：“And, Jiminy Cricket, do the locals consider Muntz the bee's knees!”（天哪，当地人可真觉得蒙兹棒极了！）

cards.ex: Consider means to think of someone in a certain way. The locals consider Muntz the bee's knees.
exs: Fans consider the explorer a hero.
lg: 你在心里给他一个位置：他是英雄，或他是骗子。
cards.note: 原句：“And, Jiminy Cricket, do the locals consider Muntz the bee's knees!”（天哪，当地人可真觉得蒙兹棒极了！）

cards.ex: In the newsreel, a walker is a machine that makes a dog run in place. In everyday US life, a walker is also the metal frame some people use to help them walk.
exs: The dog ran on a mechanical walker inside the airship.
lg: 电影里是给狗跑步的机器。美国生活里，walker 也常指老人用的助行架。
cards.note: 两个意思都值得记。这一课先记飞艇上的 mechanical canine walker，再记住生活里的助行器。 原句：“complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.”（还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。）

cards.ex: Canine means related to dogs. Muntz built the airship for canine comfort, so his dogs would feel at ease.
exs: The rooms were made for canine comfort.
lg: 不说 dog，而用一个更正式的词，新闻片听起来更气派。
cards.note: canine 也可以作名词，指狗，或犬齿。这里修饰 comfort 和 walker，是形容词。 原句：“complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.”（还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。）

cards.ex: Mechanical means run by a machine, not by hand. The dog walker on the airship is mechanical.
exs: A mechanical bath washes the dogs on board.
lg: 齿轮和马达在动，不是人手在做。
cards.note: 原句：“complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.”（还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。）

cards.ex: A bath is washing in a tub, or the tub itself. The airship has a doggie bath.
exs: The dog did not enjoy the bath.
lg: 美国口语里 bath 常指在浴缸里洗。电影里是给狗准备的。
cards.note: 动词“给……洗澡”是 bathe /beɪð/。名词洗澡是 bath /bæθ/。 原句：“complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.”（还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。）

cards.ex: Complete with means including this extra thing. The floating palace is complete with a dog bath and a mechanical dog walker.
exs: The room came complete with a soft bed for the dogs.
lg: 主物已经很豪华，后面还附带列出里面有什么。
cards.note: 和动词 complete（完成）不是一个意思。complete with 贴在名词后面，表示“还配了……”。 原句：“complete with doggy bath and mechanical canine walker.”（还配有狗狗浴池和机械遛狗机。）

cards.ex: A palace is a grand home for a king or queen. The announcer calls the airship a floating palace.
exs: The dining room looked like a palace in the sky.
lg: 又大又华丽，所以飞艇被说成一座宫殿。
cards.note: 原句：“It's a veritable floating palace in the sky,”（它简直就是一座空中漂浮的宫殿，）

cards.ex: Floating means staying up on air or water instead of falling. The airship is a floating palace.
exs: A floating palace stays up in the sky.
lg: 下面没有柱子，它自己浮着。
cards.note: 原句：“It's a veritable floating palace in the sky,”（它简直就是一座空中漂浮的宫殿，）

cards.ex: Veritable means you can truly call it that. A veritable floating palace is so grand that “palace” is a fair name.
exs: The ship is a veritable palace in the sky.
lg: 不是比喻过头。它真的豪华到配得上这个名字。
cards.note: 多放在名词前面加强语气，口语里不算最常见，但新闻片很爱用。 原句：“It's a veritable floating palace in the sky,”（它简直就是一座空中漂浮的宫殿，）

cards.ex: Comfort is the feeling of being physically at ease. Muntz designed the ship for his dogs' comfort.
exs: The dogs travel in real comfort.
lg: 身体放松，不挤、不冷、不疼。
cards.note: 形容词是 comfortable。这里 Muntz conceived the craft for canine comfort，comfort 是名词。 原句：“Muntz conceived the craft for canine comfort.”（蒙兹设计这艘飞艇时，就考虑到了狗狗的舒适。）

cards.ex: A craft is a boat, ship, or aircraft. In the newsreel, the craft is Muntz's dirigible, the machine he designed himself.
exs: Muntz designed the craft himself.
lg: 能载人移动的一台船或飞行器。
cards.note: 做美甲、手作时听到的 craft 是“手艺、工艺”。这部电影里是船或飞机。两个意思都真实，别混在同一句里。 原句：“Muntz conceived the craft for canine comfort.”（蒙兹设计这艘飞艇时，就考虑到了狗狗的舒适。）

cards.ex: Conceive means to think of an idea and design it. Muntz conceived the craft so his dogs would be comfortable.
exs: He wanted to conceive a ship that dogs would love.
lg: 想法先在脑子里成形，然后才变成一艘真的船。
cards.note: conceive 也可以表示怀孕。电影里是“构想、设计”。 原句：“Muntz conceived the craft for canine comfort.”（蒙兹设计这艘飞艇时，就考虑到了狗狗的舒适。）

cards.ex: Faithful means loyal and staying with you. Muntz is never apart from his faithful dogs.
exs: A faithful dog stays next to you.
lg: 不管新闻怎么说，狗还是跟着他。
cards.note: 原句：“Never apart from his faithful dogs,”（他从不离开他忠诚的狗狗们，）

cards.ex: Apart from means separated from. Never apart from his dogs means the dogs are always with him. In daily US English, apart from can also mean except for.
exs: He is never apart from his dogs.
lg: 两个人或人和狗之间拉开距离。电影里是“从不离开”。
cards.note: 另一个日常意思是“除了”。He is apart from the group 是分开；Apart from coffee, I drank nothing 是除了咖啡。 原句：“Never apart from his faithful dogs,”（他从不离开他忠诚的狗狗们，）

cards.ex: A wagon is a four-wheeled cart for carrying people or things. The newsreel lines up paddy wagons to show how long the airship is.
exs: The airship is longer than many wagons lined up.
lg: 四个轮子的厢式车，用来装人或装货。
cards.note: 美国也把儿童拉的小车叫 wagon。电影里用来比较长度的是 paddy wagon。 原句：“and is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons placed end to end.”（比 22 辆禁酒令时期的警车首尾相连还要长。）

cards.ex: In the old phrase paddy wagon, it means a police van. The newsreel measures the airship against Prohibition-era paddy wagons. Do not call a person a paddy. That use is an insult.
exs: A paddy wagon is an old name for a police van.
lg: 只记整词 paddy wagon：运人的警车。不要用 paddy 叫人。
cards.note: paddy 单独用来叫人，是对爱尔兰人的侮辱。学习时只说 paddy wagon，指那种老式警车。 原句：“and is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons placed end to end.”（比 22 辆禁酒令时期的警车首尾相连还要长。）

cards.ex: Prohibition was the time in the United States when alcohol was illegal, from 1920 to 1933. The newsreel jokes that the airship is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons.
exs: Prohibition was the US ban on alcohol in the 1920s.
lg: 法律把酒按下暂停键的那些年。飞艇比那个年代的警车还长。
cards.note: 动词 prohibit 是“禁止”。大写的 Prohibition 常特指美国这段历史。 原句：“and is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons placed end to end.”（比 22 辆禁酒令时期的警车首尾相连还要长。）

cards.ex: An expedition is a long, organized trip made to explore. Muntz completes a year-long expedition to the lost world.
exs: The expedition to the lost world took a whole year.
lg: 不是周末出游，是带着计划走很远的一支队伍。
cards.note: 原句：“completing a year-long expedition to the lost world.”（完成了前往失落世界、为期一年的探险。）

cards.ex: Complete means to finish something. Muntz is completing a year-long expedition when he lands in New Hampshire.
exs: He will complete the long trip this week.
lg: 行程走到最后一步，可以画上句号。
cards.note: 这是动词“完成”。前面的 complete with 是另一个短语，表示“配有”。 原句：“completing a year-long expedition to the lost world.”（完成了前往失落世界、为期一年的探险。）

cards.ex: Spirit can mean the energy or character of something. In the film, Spirit of Adventure is also the name of Muntz's dirigible.
exs: The Spirit of Adventure is the name of his airship.
lg: 一个词两个落点：人的劲头，以及那艘船的船名。
cards.note: 原句：“The beloved explorer lands his dirigible, the Spirit of Adventure,”（这位深受爱戴的探险家驾着他的飞艇“冒险精神号”降落，）

cards.ex: Beloved means deeply loved. The announcer calls Muntz the beloved explorer.
exs: The beloved explorer waved to the crowd.
lg: 不是随便喜欢，是很多人放在心上。
cards.note: 原句：“The beloved explorer lands his dirigible, the Spirit of Adventure,”（这位深受爱戴的探险家驾着他的飞艇“冒险精神号”降落，）

cards.ex: A summit is the top of a mountain. Paradise Falls sits on an inhospitable summit that few people would dare to climb.
exs: Few people dare to stand on that summit.
lg: 山的最高一点，再往上就没有路了。
cards.note: summit 也可以指峰会。这里是地理上的山顶。 原句：“Who would dare set foot on this inhospitable summit?”（谁敢踏上这座荒凉险恶的山顶？）

cards.zh: 不宜居住的；环境恶劣的
cards.ex: Inhospitable means hard to live in and not welcoming. The summit is wild, steep, and dangerous.
exs: An inhospitable mountain has no easy shelter.
lg: 地方本身在赶人：太冷、太陡、没有遮风的地方。
cards.note: 反义词是 hospitable，指人或地方好客。in- 把意思反过来。 原句：“Who would dare set foot on this inhospitable summit?”（谁敢踏上这座荒凉险恶的山顶？）

cards.ex: Dare means to be brave enough to do something risky. The announcer asks who would dare set foot on that summit.
exs: Who would dare set foot on that wild mountain?
lg: 脚还没踩上去，人已经知道这很危险。
cards.note: 原句：“Who would dare set foot on this inhospitable summit?”（谁敢踏上这座荒凉险恶的山顶？）

cards.ex: Sport means to have or show something noticeable. The lost world sports plants and animals that science has not named.
exs: The jungle can sport flowers no one has named.
lg: 一个地方把少见的东西“穿”在外面，让你看见。
cards.note: 这里不是名词“体育运动”。新闻片说 it sports plants and animals：它有这些植物和动物。 原句：“Lurking in the shadow of majestic Paradise Falls, it sports plants and animals undiscovered by science.”（它隐藏在雄伟的天堂瀑布的阴影里，拥有科学尚未发现的植物和动物。）

cards.ex: Lurking means staying hidden and waiting, usually where you cannot see it clearly. The beast is lurking in the shadow of Paradise Falls.
exs: Something is lurking in the shadow of the falls.
lg: 你看见阴影，还没看见里面的东西。它在等。
cards.note: 词表给的是 lurking。原形是 lurk。 原句：“Lurking in the shadow of majestic Paradise Falls, it sports plants and animals undiscovered by science.”（它隐藏在雄伟的天堂瀑布的阴影里，拥有科学尚未发现的植物和动物。）

cards.ex: Majestic means grand and impressive. Paradise Falls is a majestic waterfall dropping off a flat mountain.
exs: The majestic falls drop off a flat mountain.
lg: 大到让人安静一下，觉得它有王者的气势。
cards.note: 原句：“Lurking in the shadow of majestic Paradise Falls, it sports plants and animals undiscovered by science.”（它隐藏在雄伟的天堂瀑布的阴影里，拥有科学尚未发现的植物和动物。）

cards.ex: Humanity means all people. The footage had never been seen by civilized humanity, the announcer says.
exs: The film shows a place humanity had not seen.
lg: 不是一个人，是所有人算在一起。
cards.note: 另一个意思是“人道、人性”。这里是“全人类”。 原句：“What you are now witnessing is footage never before seen by civilized humanity,”（您现在看到的，是文明人类从未见过的影像，）

cards.ex: Civilized, in this old newsreel voice, means from settled modern society. The announcer says civilized humanity had never seen this footage.
exs: The announcer said civilized humanity had never seen this place.
lg: 1930 年代新闻片的口气，把“我们这边的人”叫做 civilized。
cards.note: 拿 civilized 评价现在的真实人群，听起来会傲慢。这里只学新闻片里的用法，不要拿它说别人落后。 原句：“What you are now witnessing is footage never before seen by civilized humanity,”（您现在看到的，是文明人类从未见过的影像，）

cards.ex: Footage is filmed pictures. The newsreel says you are watching footage never shown before.
exs: This footage is the first film of that waterfall.
lg: 已经拍下来的画面，可以在新闻片里播。
cards.note: footage 通常不可数，不说 footages。 原句：“What you are now witnessing is footage never before seen by civilized humanity,”（您现在看到的，是文明人类从未见过的影像，）

cards.ex: Witness means to see something happen with your own eyes. “What you are now witnessing” means what you are seeing on the screen right now.
exs: You witness a lost world on the movie screen.
lg: 不是听说，是自己的眼睛正在看着它发生。
cards.note: witness 也可以是名词：目击者。新闻片里是动词 witnessing。 原句：“What you are now witnessing is footage never before seen by civilized humanity,”（您现在看到的，是文明人类从未见过的影像，）

cards.ex: A spotlight is a strong light aimed at one person or thing. Spotlight on Adventure is the name of the newsreel, meaning this story is the focus.
exs: The newsreel is called Spotlight on Adventure.
lg: 一束光打在主角身上，别的都暗下去。节目名也是这个意思。
cards.note: 原句：“Movietown News presents: Spotlight on Adventure.”（《电影城新闻》为您呈现：冒险聚光灯。）

cards.ex: Present, said pri-ZENT, means to introduce or put on a show. Movietown News presents Spotlight on Adventure. A gift is a different word, said PREZ-ent.
exs: The newsreel will present a story about an explorer.
lg: 片头把节目交到观众面前：现在开始播这个。
cards.note: 动词 present 重音在第二音节 /prɪˈzent/：播出、介绍、颁发。名词“礼物”和形容词“在场的”是 /ˈpreznt/，重音在第一音节。 原句：“Movietown News presents: Spotlight on Adventure.”（《电影城新闻》为您呈现：冒险聚光灯。）

items.ex: Back out means you promised to do something, then you decide not to do it. Ellie tells Carl there is no backing out of the trip.
exs: Do not back out of a promise you made to a friend.
exzh: 不要退出你对朋友许下的承诺。

items.ex: Cross your heart means you promise, and you trace a small cross over your heart. Ellie says “Cross your heart” before she shows Carl her book.
exs: Cross your heart before you break a promise.
exzh: 发誓之前，先在胸口画个十字。

items.ex: A blimp is a big airship filled with gas. Ellie asks Carl to take them to Paradise Falls in a blimp.
exs: Ellie wanted Carl to fly them there in a blimp.
exzh: Ellie 想让 Carl 开飞艇带他们去。

items.ex: A clubhouse is the little home base of a club. Ellie wants to move her clubhouse next to Paradise Falls.
exs: Ellie wants her clubhouse right next to the waterfall.
exzh: Ellie 想把她的俱乐部小屋挪到瀑布旁边。

items.ex: Out of means from inside something, or from a direction. Ellie rips a picture out of a library book, and she also calls the wind “out of the east.”
exs: Ellie ripped the picture out of a library book.
exzh: Ellie 把那张画从图书馆的书里撕了下来。

items.ex: Ripped means tore something by pulling. Ellie ripped a page out of a library book.
exs: She ripped the picture out of a book.
exzh: 她把那张画从书里撕了下来。

items.ex: Swear means you promise something very seriously. Ellie makes Carl swear he will not tell anyone about her book.
exs: You have to swear you will not tell anyone.
exzh: 你得发誓，谁也不告诉。

items.ex: Cheer up means to help someone feel happier. Ellie climbs through the window to cheer Carl up after he breaks his arm.
exs: A visit from a friend can cheer up a bad day.
exzh: 朋友来看你，能把糟糕的一天变好一点。

items.ex: Aboard means on a ship or airship, or inside the group. Ellie says “Welcome aboard” when Carl joins her explorer club.
exs: Ellie said welcome aboard when Carl joined the club.
exzh: Carl 加入俱乐部时，Ellie 说欢迎上船。

items.ex: Goggles are glasses that protect your eyes from wind. Young Carl and Ellie wear flight goggles like Charles Muntz.
exs: Carl put on his goggles before he crossed the beam.
exzh: Carl 走过横梁之前戴上了护目镜。

items.ex: A helmet is a hard hat that protects your head. Ellie wears a flight helmet in her pretend cockpit.
exs: Ellie took off her helmet and her hair stuck out.
exzh: Ellie 摘下头盔，头发都炸开了。

items.ex: Exclusive means only a special group may join. Ellie says her club is exclusive: only explorers get in.
exs: The club is exclusive, so not every kid can walk in.
exzh: 这个俱乐部是专属的，不是每个孩子都能进。

items.ex: Hail is small balls of ice that fall in a storm. Ellie shouts “Lightning! Hail!” while she pretends to fly.
exs: Hail started to hit the pretend airship.
exzh: 冰雹开始打在那艘假装的飞艇上。

items.ex: A storm is heavy rain and wind, often with lightning. Ellie yells that a storm is coming, and later a real storm throws the house around.
exs: A sudden storm can throw a little house around in the sky.
exzh: 突然的暴风雨能把一栋小房子在天上甩来甩去。

items.ex: Weather is what the sky is doing: sun, wind, rain, or a storm. Ellie tells her hamster to enter the weather in the logbook.
exs: Ellie wrote the weather in her logbook.
exzh: Ellie 把天气写进了航海日志。

items.ex: Unlimited means there is no limit. Ellie says visibility is unlimited, so she can see very far on a clear day.
exs: On a clear day the visibility is unlimited.
exzh: 晴天的时候，能见度没有尽头。

items.ex: Visibility is how far you can see. Pilots talk about visibility before they fly.
exs: Good visibility means a pilot can see a long way.
exzh: 能见度好，飞行员就能看很远。

items.ex: A rudder is the flat piece that steers a ship or airship. Ellie calls “Rudders eighteen degrees towards the south.”
exs: The pilot moved the rudder to turn the airship.
exzh: 飞行员扳动方向舵，让飞艇转弯。

items.ex: Starboard is the right side of a ship or airship when you face the front. Ellie shouts “Hard to starboard.”
exs: Hard to starboard means turn the ship sharply to the right.
exzh: Hard to starboard 的意思是把船猛地转向右边。

items.ex: Hurdle means to jump over something. The newsreel says Muntz hurdles mountains in his airship, while little Carl jumps the cracks in the sidewalk.
exs: The explorer can hurdle a canyon in his airship.
exzh: 探险家能开着飞艇跃过一道峡谷。

items.ex: A dirigible is a large airship you can steer. Muntz flies one called the Spirit of Adventure.
exs: Muntz landed his dirigible in New Hampshire.
exzh: Muntz 把飞艇降落在新罕布什尔。

items.ex: Famous means lots of people know you. The newsreel shows Charles Muntz piloting his famous dirigible.
exs: The famous explorer waved from his airship.
exzh: 那位有名的探险家从飞艇上向人群挥手。

items.ex: Piloting means flying and steering an aircraft. The newsreel says Charles Muntz is piloting his famous dirigible.
exs: Muntz is piloting the Spirit of Adventure.
exzh: Muntz 正在驾驶“冒险精神号”。

items.ex: A beast is a large wild animal or a monster. Muntz promises to capture the beast of Paradise Falls alive.
exs: Muntz wants to capture the beast alive.
exzh: Muntz 想把那只巨兽活捉回来。

items.ex: Capture means to catch someone or something and hold it. Muntz wants to capture the beast alive, not just bring back bones.
exs: He promised to capture the animal and clear his name.
exzh: 他答应活捉那只动物，洗清自己的名声。

items.ex: Vow means to promise in a strong, serious way. Muntz vows to return to Paradise Falls and not come back until he finds the beast.
exs: Muntz will vow to bring the beast back alive.
exzh: Muntz 会发誓把巨兽活着带回来。

items.ex: Strip of means to take away a title or a right. The explorers' organization strips Muntz of his membership.
exs: The club can strip a member of his badge.
exzh: 俱乐部可以剥夺会员的徽章。

items.ex: An organization is a formal group with a name and rules. In the film it is the National Explorers Society.
exs: The organization took away his membership.
exzh: 那个组织取消了他的会员资格。

items.ex: A skeleton is the full set of bones. Muntz brings back a giant bird skeleton, and scientists say it is not real.
exs: Scientists studied the giant bird skeleton.
exzh: 科学家研究了那具巨鸟骨架。

items.ex: Fabricate means to invent something false or build a fake. Scientists say Muntz fabricated the skeleton.
exs: People said he might fabricate the whole story.
exzh: 人们说他可能把整件事编造出来。

items.ex: Accuse means to say someone did something wrong. The society accuses Muntz of faking the skeleton.
exs: The society will accuse him of a fake discovery.
exzh: 学会会指控他的发现是假的。

items.ex: Cry foul means to say something is unfair or against the rules. Scientists cry foul about Muntz's skeleton.
exs: The scientists cry foul when the bones look fake.
exzh: 骨头看起来是假的，科学家就大喊不公平。

items.ex: A scientist is a person who studies the natural world and asks for proof. The scientists do not trust Muntz's skeleton.
exs: A scientist asked for proof of the giant bird.
exzh: 一位科学家要求拿出巨鸟的证据。

items.ex: Swell is an old-fashioned way to say great or wonderful. The announcer says “what a swell monster.”
exs: In old movies, swell means wonderful.
exzh: 在老电影里，swell 的意思是“棒极了”。

items.ex: Golly is an old, gentle way to show surprise. The announcer says “And golly, what a swell monster.”
exs: Golly, that airship is longer than a city block.
exzh: 天哪，那艘飞艇比一条街区还长。

items.zh: 最棒的人或东西（老俚语）
items.ex: The bee's knees is old slang for the best person or thing. The locals consider Muntz the bee's knees.
exs: In the 1930s, the bee's knees meant the very best.
exzh: 在 1930 年代，the bee's knees 就是“最棒的”。

items.ex: Consider means to think of someone in a certain way. The locals consider Muntz the bee's knees.
exs: Fans consider the explorer a hero.
exzh: 粉丝们把这位探险家看作英雄。

items.ex: In the newsreel, a walker is a machine that makes a dog run in place. In everyday US life, a walker is also the metal frame some people use to help them walk.
exs: The dog ran on a mechanical walker inside the airship.
exzh: 狗在飞艇里的机械步道上跑。

items.ex: Canine means related to dogs. Muntz built the airship for canine comfort, so his dogs would feel at ease.
exs: The rooms were made for canine comfort.
exzh: 这些房间是为了让狗舒服而做的。

items.ex: Mechanical means run by a machine, not by hand. The dog walker on the airship is mechanical.
exs: A mechanical bath washes the dogs on board.
exzh: 船上有一台机械洗澡装置给狗洗澡。

items.ex: A bath is washing in a tub, or the tub itself. The airship has a doggie bath.
exs: The dog did not enjoy the bath.
exzh: 那只狗并不喜欢这次洗澡。

items.ex: Complete with means including this extra thing. The floating palace is complete with a dog bath and a mechanical dog walker.
exs: The room came complete with a soft bed for the dogs.
exzh: 这个房间配有一张给狗睡的软床。

items.ex: A palace is a grand home for a king or queen. The announcer calls the airship a floating palace.
exs: The dining room looked like a palace in the sky.
exzh: 餐厅看起来像一座天上的宫殿。

items.ex: Floating means staying up on air or water instead of falling. The airship is a floating palace.
exs: A floating palace stays up in the sky.
exzh: 一座漂浮的宫殿停在天上。

items.ex: Veritable means you can truly call it that. A veritable floating palace is so grand that “palace” is a fair name.
exs: The ship is a veritable palace in the sky.
exzh: 这艘船是一座名副其实的天上宫殿。

items.ex: Comfort is the feeling of being physically at ease. Muntz designed the ship for his dogs' comfort.
exs: The dogs travel in real comfort.
exzh: 这些狗旅行时真的很舒服。

items.ex: A craft is a boat, ship, or aircraft. In the newsreel, the craft is Muntz's dirigible, the machine he designed himself.
exs: Muntz designed the craft himself.
exzh: 这艘飞船是 Muntz 自己设计的。

items.ex: Conceive means to think of an idea and design it. Muntz conceived the craft so his dogs would be comfortable.
exs: He wanted to conceive a ship that dogs would love.
exzh: 他想构想出一艘狗会喜欢的船。

items.ex: Faithful means loyal and staying with you. Muntz is never apart from his faithful dogs.
exs: A faithful dog stays next to you.
exzh: 忠诚的狗会待在你身边。

items.ex: Apart from means separated from. Never apart from his dogs means the dogs are always with him. In daily US English, apart from can also mean except for.
exs: He is never apart from his dogs.
exzh: 他从不和自己的狗分开。

items.ex: A wagon is a four-wheeled cart for carrying people or things. The newsreel lines up paddy wagons to show how long the airship is.
exs: The airship is longer than many wagons lined up.
exzh: 这艘飞艇比很多辆货车排成一排还长。

items.ex: In the old phrase paddy wagon, it means a police van. The newsreel measures the airship against Prohibition-era paddy wagons. Do not call a person a paddy. That use is an insult.
exs: A paddy wagon is an old name for a police van.
exzh: paddy wagon 是警车的一种老说法。

items.ex: Prohibition was the time in the United States when alcohol was illegal, from 1920 to 1933. The newsreel jokes that the airship is longer than 22 Prohibition paddy wagons.
exs: Prohibition was the US ban on alcohol in the 1920s.
exzh: 禁酒令是 1920 年代美国禁止酒类的法律时期。

items.ex: An expedition is a long, organized trip made to explore. Muntz completes a year-long expedition to the lost world.
exs: The expedition to the lost world took a whole year.
exzh: 去失落世界的那次远征花了整整一年。

items.ex: Complete means to finish something. Muntz is completing a year-long expedition when he lands in New Hampshire.
exs: He will complete the long trip this week.
exzh: 他这周会完成这次长途旅行。

items.ex: Spirit can mean the energy or character of something. In the film, Spirit of Adventure is also the name of Muntz's dirigible.
exs: The Spirit of Adventure is the name of his airship.
exzh: “冒险精神号”是他那艘飞艇的名字。

items.ex: Beloved means deeply loved. The announcer calls Muntz the beloved explorer.
exs: The beloved explorer waved to the crowd.
exzh: 这位深受喜爱的探险家向人群挥手。

items.ex: A summit is the top of a mountain. Paradise Falls sits on an inhospitable summit that few people would dare to climb.
exs: Few people dare to stand on that summit.
exzh: 很少有人敢站上那座山顶。

items.zh: 不宜居住的；环境恶劣的
items.ex: Inhospitable means hard to live in and not welcoming. The summit is wild, steep, and dangerous.
exs: An inhospitable mountain has no easy shelter.
exzh: 一座环境恶劣的山，找不到容易的落脚处。

items.ex: Dare means to be brave enough to do something risky. The announcer asks who would dare set foot on that summit.
exs: Who would dare set foot on that wild mountain?
exzh: 谁敢踏上那座荒山？

items.ex: Sport means to have or show something noticeable. The lost world sports plants and animals that science has not named.
exs: The jungle can sport flowers no one has named.
exzh: 这片丛林能长出谁都没命名过的花。

items.ex: Lurking means staying hidden and waiting, usually where you cannot see it clearly. The beast is lurking in the shadow of Paradise Falls.
exs: Something is lurking in the shadow of the falls.
exzh: 有什么东西潜伏在瀑布的阴影里。

items.ex: Majestic means grand and impressive. Paradise Falls is a majestic waterfall dropping off a flat mountain.
exs: The majestic falls drop off a flat mountain.
exzh: 壮丽的瀑布从一座平顶山泻下来。

items.ex: Humanity means all people. The footage had never been seen by civilized humanity, the announcer says.
exs: The film shows a place humanity had not seen.
exzh: 这片子展示了一个人类还没见过的地方。

items.ex: Civilized, in this old newsreel voice, means from settled modern society. The announcer says civilized humanity had never seen this footage.
exs: The announcer said civilized humanity had never seen this place.
exzh: 播音员说，文明社会的人从没见过这个地方。

items.ex: Footage is filmed pictures. The newsreel says you are watching footage never shown before.
exs: This footage is the first film of that waterfall.
exzh: 这段影像是那座瀑布的第一批影片。

items.ex: Witness means to see something happen with your own eyes. “What you are now witnessing” means what you are seeing on the screen right now.
exs: You witness a lost world on the movie screen.
exzh: 你在电影屏幕上亲眼看见一个失落的世界。

items.ex: A spotlight is a strong light aimed at one person or thing. Spotlight on Adventure is the name of the newsreel, meaning this story is the focus.
exs: The newsreel is called Spotlight on Adventure.
exzh: 这部新闻片叫做《探险聚光灯》。

items.ex: Present, said pri-ZENT, means to introduce or put on a show. Movietown News presents Spotlight on Adventure. A gift is a different word, said PREZ-ent.
exs: The newsreel will present a story about an explorer.
exzh: 新闻片会播出一个关于探险家的故事。

items.s: Ellie told Carl not to ___ of the trip.
items.why: to 后面用动词原形。back out 是“说话不算数、不干了”。

items.s: Ellie told him to ___ his heart.
items.why: to 后面用动词原形。Cross your heart 是发誓的动作。

items.s: Carl wanted a ___ for the long trip.
items.why: a 后面接名词。一艘飞艇用单数 blimp。

items.s: Ellie wanted her ___ next to the falls.
items.why: her 后面是名词。她只有一间小屋，用单数。

items.s: Ellie pulled the page ___ a library book.
items.why: pulled the page out of a book：从书里面拿出来。整段 out of 一起填。

items.s: Ellie ___ that page from a library book.
items.why: 这件事已经发生，动词用过去式 ripped。原形是 rip。

items.s: Carl had to ___ secrecy to Ellie.
items.why: had to 后面用动词原形 swear。过去式是 swore。

items.s: Ellie wanted to ___ the boy with the broken arm.
items.why: wanted to 后面用动词原形。cheer up 是短语动词，两个词一起用。

items.s: Ellie told Carl to come ___ the pretend ship.
items.why: come aboard 是上船、加入。aboard 修饰这个动作，按副词练。

items.s: Carl wanted his ___ before the jump.
items.why: 一副护目镜用复数 goggles。

items.s: Ellie removed her ___ in the clubhouse.
items.why: her 后面是名词。她摘的是一顶头盔。

items.s: Ellie kept an ___ club for explorers.
items.why: 空格在名词 club 前面，用来描述它，用形容词 exclusive。

items.s: Ellie shouted about lightning and ___.
items.why: and 后面跟闪电并列的是名词冰雹。这题选 hail。

items.s: Ellie warned Carl about a sudden ___.
items.why: a sudden 后面接名词。stormy 是形容词。

items.s: Ellie recorded the ___ in her logbook.
items.why: the 后面是名词。weather 一般不用复数。

items.s: Ellie reported ___ visibility from the cockpit.
items.why: 空格在名词 visibility 前面，描述能见度，用形容词 unlimited。

items.s: The pilot checked the ___ before takeoff.
items.why: the 后面接名词。visible 是形容词“看得见的”。

items.s: Ellie moved the ___ to turn south.
items.why: the 后面是名词。一块舵用单数 rudder。

items.s: Ellie called for a hard turn to ___.
items.why: to 后面是右舷这个名称，按名词练。

items.s: The airship had to ___ a high mountain.
items.why: had to 后面用动词原形 hurdle。

items.s: Muntz landed his ___ in New Hampshire.
items.why: his 后面接名词。一艘飞艇用单数。

items.s: The crowd cheered the ___ explorer.
items.why: 空格在名词 explorer 前面，用形容词 famous。

items.s: The newsreel shows Muntz ___ his airship.
items.why: shows 后面这个动作正在发生，用 piloting。

items.s: Muntz hoped to catch the ___ alive.
items.why: the 后面是名词。这只巨兽用单数 beast。

items.s: Muntz hoped to ___ the beast alive.
items.why: hoped to 后面用动词原形 capture。

items.s: Muntz started to ___ a return to the falls.
items.why: started to 后面用动词原形 vow。

items.s: The club decided to ___ him of his membership.
items.why: decided to 后面用动词原形。strip him of 是固定搭配。

items.s: The ___ removed his membership.
items.why: The 后面、动词 removed 前面，是名词主语。

items.s: Scientists studied the giant ___.
items.why: the giant 后面接名词。一具骨架用单数。

items.s: They refused to ___ a fake skeleton.
items.why: refused to 后面用动词原形 fabricate。

items.s: The society began to ___ him of a fake discovery.
items.why: began to 后面用动词原形。accuse him of 是固定搭配。

items.s: The scientists cried ___ about the fake bones.
items.why: cry foul 是固定说法，foul 在这里是名词“犯规、不公”。

items.s: A ___ asked for proof of the giant bird.
items.why: A 后面接单数名词 scientist。

items.s: The announcer called it a ___ monster.
items.why: a 和 monster 中间用形容词。这里 swell 是“很棒”，不是“肿”。

items.s: The announcer yelled ___ at the huge ship.
items.why: golly 是感叹，没有别的词形。这题把它放在副词一类：它不描述名词，只表达吃惊。

items.s: In that old slang he was the ___.
items.why: the 后面是一个名词短语。撇号要留在 bee's 里。

items.s: The locals began to ___ him a hero.
items.why: began to 后面用动词原形 consider。

items.s: One dog ran on a mechanical ___.
items.why: a mechanical 后面接名词 walker。

items.s: Muntz designed the ship for ___ comfort.
items.why: 空格在名词 comfort 前面，意思是“狗的”，用形容词。

items.s: The dog used a ___ walker on the ship.
items.why: 空格在名词 walker 前面，用形容词 mechanical。

items.s: The dog hated the noisy ___.
items.why: the noisy 后面接名词 bath。动词是 bathe。

items.s: The room came ___ a soft dog bed.
items.why: came complete with 表示“来的时候就配好了”。两个词要一起填。

items.s: The announcer called the ship a floating ___.
items.why: a floating 后面接名词 palace。

items.s: They filmed the ___ palace in the sky.
items.why: 空格在名词 palace 前面，用形容词 floating。动词原形是 float。

items.s: The ship was a ___ palace in the sky.
items.why: a 和 palace 中间用形容词 veritable。

items.s: Muntz built the ship for his dogs' ___.
items.why: dogs' 后面接名词 comfort。comfortable 是形容词。

items.s: Muntz designed the whole ___ himself.
items.why: the whole 后面接名词。这里 craft 是飞船，不是手艺。

items.s: Muntz wanted to ___ a ship for his dogs.
items.why: wanted to 后面用动词原形 conceive。

items.s: Muntz traveled with his ___ dogs.
items.why: his 和 dogs 中间用形容词 faithful。

items.s: Muntz never stayed ___ his dogs.
items.why: stayed apart from 是“和……分开待着”。from 要一起填。

items.s: The newsreel lined up many ___ to show the length.
items.why: many 后面用复数名词 wagons。

items.s: The joke measured the ship with an old ___ wagon.
items.why: old 和 wagon 中间是这个复合词的前半。不要用它称呼人。

items.s: The joke pointed back to ___ in the United States.
items.why: to 后面接名词 prohibition。动词是 prohibit。

items.s: Muntz finished a year-long ___.
items.why: a year-long 后面接名词 expedition。

items.s: Muntz hoped to ___ the long expedition.
items.why: hoped to 后面用动词原形。这里是“完成”，不是 complete with。

items.s: The airship's name is the ___ of Adventure.
items.why: the 和 of Adventure 中间是名词 spirit。船名里要大写，练习里填这个词。

items.s: The crowd loved the ___ explorer.
items.why: 空格在名词 explorer 前面，用形容词 beloved。

items.s: Few explorers reached that wild ___.
items.why: that wild 后面接名词 summit。

items.s: The film showed an ___ summit above the clouds.
items.why: an 和 summit 中间用形容词。inhospitable 表示不适合停留。

items.s: Few explorers ___ to climb that summit.
items.why: 空格是句子的主要动词“敢”。climb 是 to 后面的另一个动词，也要点出来。

items.s: The lost world seemed to ___ strange plants.
items.why: seemed to 后面用动词原形。这里 sport 是“长着”，不是体育运动。

items.s: A beast was ___ in the shadow of the falls.
items.why: was 后面这个动作正在持续，用 lurking。

items.s: The camera showed the ___ falls.
items.why: the 和 falls 中间用形容词 majestic。

items.s: The pictures surprised all of ___.
items.why: all of 后面接名词 humanity，表示全人类。

items.s: The announcer spoke to ___ humanity.
items.why: 空格在名词 humanity 前面，用形容词 civilized。

items.s: The newsreel played new ___ of the falls.
items.why: new 后面接不可数名词 footage。不要改成 foot。

items.s: Viewers began to ___ a lost world.
items.why: began to 后面用动词原形 witness。

items.s: The show's name put the story in the ___.
items.why: in the 后面接名词 spotlight。

items.s: The newsreel wanted to ___ a new adventure.
items.why: wanted to 后面用动词原形。这里读 pri-ZENT，是“播出”，不是礼物。
